_how_to_grade: The desk's grading ledger — one entry per resolved market; the build joins by slug and computes every record, Brier score, and calibration point from here. NATIVE forecast (docs/forecast/data/{slug}.json exists): {"slug", "winner" (must name the winning entity; matched case-insensitively against consensus + profile picks), "winner_flag" (optional emoji), "resolved" (YYYY-MM-DD), "note" (one sentence on what happened), "source_url"/"source_label" (optional)}. RESEARCH market (harvested from a corpus manifest): {"slug" (the corpus slug), "outcome" (the winning scenario's exact name, case-insensitive), "resolved", "note", "source_url"/"source_label"}. Then rebuild: python3 build.py -c build.config.json.

resolutions.note: Erling Haaland scored twice in the final eleven minutes (79', 90') to send Norway through 2-1; Neymar's penalty in stoppage time came too late. Norway reached the World Cup quarterfinals for the first time.
Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev 6-7(7-9), 7-6(7-2), 6-3, 6-4 to defend his title — his second Wimbledon and fifth major overall.

Ninth seed Linda Nosková beat fellow Czech Karolína Muchová 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 for her maiden major, extending the tournament's first-time-champion streak — Sabalenka fell in the semifinals, her fourth straight loss at that stage.

Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife Stadium, substitute Ferran Torres scoring in the 105th minute, for Spain's second World Cup title. France, the council's favorite, did not reach the final.

LeBron signed a two-year, $8M deal with Philadelphia — his 'last decision' — joining Joel Embiid and newly-acquired Jaylen Brown, after weeks of speculation centered on Cleveland, Miami, and Golden State.

DOJ's Office of Legal Counsel ruled the restructured, majority-American-owned TikTok USDS joint venture falls outside the No TikTok on Government Devices Act, clearing it for federal devices — the clearest government treatment yet of the deal as a qualified divestiture, with ByteDance's stake capped just under 20%.
Top seed Alexander Zverev beat American Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2 for his second major of the season, sinking the Sinner and Alcaraz picks and the council's favorite.

Second seed Elena Rybakina beat two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 for her first US Open title, ending Sabalenka's bid for a three-peat and lifting Rybakina to world No. 1 for the first time.

The Astros clinched their eighth AL West title on the final day of the regular season, their 19th playoff appearance, despite the council's NO-leaning call. Houston finished at 81 wins, the fewest ever for a playoff team.

resolutions.winner: CR or deal averts a lapse (NO SHUTDOWN)
resolutions.note: A stopgap funding law signed in early September kept the government funded through the October 1 fiscal-year start, so no lapse occurred and no shutdown began.
The FOMC voted 12–0 to raise the target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00%, the first hike since 2023, with Chair Warsh saying the inflation standard for action had not been met.
LeBron James agreed a two-year, $8M deal with the Philadelphia 76ers (player option in year two), not Cleveland; the Cavaliers consensus missed.
